correctness.rationale: Exhaustive connected-triple face classification gives an exact union of joins and cones, with missing-edge intervals. The attaching inclusion is nullhomotopic through the discrete-to-complete-graph inclusion, yielding integral sphere-wedge homotopy types. Natural Alexander duality, top-dimensional primitive cycle sublattices and explicit integral loop bases establish all persistent maps. The actual 54-instance standalone finite-face and mod-two checker passes; its finite reach is not used to infer the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: A natural all-parameter classification of homotopy of ordinary three-cut Alexander duals under repeated incident star faults, with split integral persistence of the original cut complexes and a sharp last-edge birth of a-1 classes. This determines a family-wide intrinsic topology question and is more than a special case of known one-edge or matching formulas.
